Fig. 2: Inferred event ordering and survival in astrocytoma

This standalone package includes the statistical recomputation and data-minimization milestones. Rebuilding requires the author-request inputs described in data access, alongside the Git inputs. Survival models, displayed Cox contrasts, TP53 dosage regression and all three chronology tests/BH families are recomputed and checked; DESeq2 and timing estimates remain frozen. Reference artwork is used only for comparison. Panel-level visual review against the current manuscript is complete; small rendering residuals are documented. A future changed render requires renewed review. See the statistical methods, scope and validation record.

source(file.path(repo,'functions/R/entrypoint.R'))
if(params$rebuild)run_reproduction(repo,c('--figures','2','--output-dir',out))
stopifnot(file.exists(file.path(out,'figures/Figure_2.png')))

The original manuscript captions and displayed event-label mappings are retained in reference/main_figure_captions.txt.

The figure is available as a vector PDF in outputs/figures/Figure_2.pdf.

checks <- jsonlite::fromJSON(file.path(out,'verification/statistical_verification.json'),simplifyVector=FALSE)
summary <- do.call(rbind,lapply(names(checks$checks),function(k){
 z<-checks$checks[[k]];data.frame(check=k,pass=z$pass,max_absolute_error=z$maximum_absolute_error)
}))
